parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the swimlane group.

parameters.name: LabelSelectorKey
parameters.description: The label of the workload. The value is fixed to `ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG`.

parameters.name: LabelSelectorValue
parameters.description: The value of the `ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG` label for the service workload.

parameters.name: ServicesList
parameters.description: The list of services to associate with the swimlane. The value is a JSON array. The format for a single service is `$ClusterName/$ClusterID/$Namespace/$ServiceName`.
